hypothesis: Information-directed intervention acquisition from identical observed-action candidate sets, with identical online ridge learners and equal confirmed outcome calls, improves out-of-sample causal consequence predictions vs the strongest fully trained passive intervention policy; maintains exact cold Task-0 knowledge after Task-1.

source.kind: FRESH AUTHOR-SYNTHETIC DEVELOPMENT; NOT EXTERNAL OR OOD
source.causal_map: two independent world-specific rank4 16x16 M=V@U.T/256, deterministic P86 basis seeded independently by task and world
source.action_candidates: seeded 16D integer /128 (anisotropic scales coordinate j by floor-div 2**(j%4)), normalized to unit; generated before choice, same for all policies
source.outcome_boundary: WorldEnvironment observes committed selected integer candidate index, then returns ONLY selected action's M@normalized(action); no counterfactual outcome or latent M to chooser
source.query_boundary: 12 novel independent actions withheld from learner; evaluator-only outcomes generated after task training

learner.kind: identical regularized online recursive least squares for every policy
learner.input_output: confirmed action16 -> effect16 causal map, no tokens
learner.model_state_per_task: W 16x16 float64 + P inverse precision 16x16 float64; 512 floats per task, 1024 total for two tasks
learner.update: P' = P - (Pk)(Pk)^T/(1+k^T Pk), W' = W + (y-Wk)(Pk)^T/(1+k^T Pk), only AFTER confirmed selected effect

policies.candidate: max_variance: choose candidate with highest k.T@P@k, first-index tie; no outcome lookahead
policies.hash_random: independent seeded candidate index without effect
policies.max_norm: choose candidate with largest unnormalized candidate vector norm, first-index tie
policies.selection: One strongest passive per FAMILY and FIT seed (same index 0/1/2 as its CAL seed), selected on FIT only by world-averaged (Task0+Task1) heldout MSE; first tie by listed passive ordering; no CAL-dependent selection

acceptance.primary: CAL mean per-world two-task 16D effect MSE under 12 withheld query actions per task, lower better; world mean then seed mean

measurement.budget: 12 FIT worlds? EXACT 24 FIT/12 CAL per seed, 6 seed pairs total, 16 confirmed source calls per world per policy
measurement.matched_cpu: each policy entire 2-task 16 intervention choose+confirmed oracle+model-write+24 novel query read on fixed 8 world batch; 2 warmups +7 timed trials; no diagnostic telemetry in timed block
measurement.negative_controls: counterfactual label sealed, wrong-time credit destroys learned causality, cold checkpoint, read-only queries

qualification.source: P86 original and P97/P98/P99 original SHA/frozen source unchanged
qualification.platforms: G4 Windows+Ubuntu full final regression; G5 native TTT CPU both OS; G7 pinned Mamba2 Ubuntu CPU
qualification.test: existing G4 pytest and existing artifact local_runs/p101_dev_result.json, no new workflows
